# Tokenization Request Requirements

Spec for PAY-2291.

## Card (`card`)
- `card.token_ref`: required, string, pattern `^tok_[A-Za-z0-9]+$`.
- `card.pan`: required, string. Strip spaces and dashes, then 13–19 digits, Luhn-valid.
- `card.expiry`: required, `MM/YYYY`. Must not be in the past. Must be no more than 7 years from the current date.
- `card.cvv`: MUST NOT be present anywhere in the payload. Reject with error mentioning `cvv`.
- `card.billing.address`: required object with `line1` (string, 1–200 chars), `postal_code` (string, 1–20 chars), `country` (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, uppercase).

## Metadata (`metadata`)
- Optional object. `merchant_id` required string matching `^MRC-[0-9]{4}$`. `order_ref` optional string, max 64 chars.

## Token policy (`token_policy`)
- Optional object. `ttl_seconds`: integer, 60–86400. `single_use`: boolean, default true.

## General
- Max nesting depth: 6. Error message must mention `depth`.
- Null, empty string, and unicode inputs must produce `ValidationError`, never an unhandled exception.
- Unknown top-level keys: reject.
